protocol: The implementation was frozen before the blind-v4 benchmark was authored.
Expected labels will be defined before the benchmark is executed.
The benchmark will be committed before its first execution.
No blind-v4 result will be consulted while constructing or labeling the benchmark.
The implementation will not be tuned on blind-v4 before the first-run result is recorded.
The benchmark is internally authored and is not an externally independent evaluation.
